verdict.rationale: Google's Drive developer docs list 'Modify files in bulk' as a supported use case. The list method can return all of a user's files, which supports bulk enumeration, and folder-level access is inherited by every file inside it. Community users do bulk export and backup through the third-party rclone CLI, but the first-party bulk support is only a one-line use-case mention with no documented batch API or bulk-operation mechanics. Missing for 10: documented batch/bulk request endpoint or bulk-edit semantics, first-party bulk tooling beyond a use-case bullet, independent hands-on corroboration of bulk modification via Google's own tools.
